recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in core unless HL7 changes the implementation-registration mechanism or wants a different canonical registry target.
issue_request: FHIR-25118 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the FHIR-core versioning page. It reported that the last paragraph of section 2.8.5 at http://hl7.org/fhir/versioning.html#changes linked to http://fhir.org/implementations/usage, which returned a 404, and requested a working implementation-registration target.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-25118 was found. The broken usage link was present when source/versioning.html was introduced by GF#16165, and the seed issue appears not to have had a separately tagged application commit. A later Applied issue, FHIR-45946, already fixed the same stale implementation-registration target in source/versioning.html on the combined branch.
additional_context: The direct 2019 Zulip report for this broken versioning.html link identified http://fhir.org/implementations/registry/ as the likely correct URL, and Grahame Grieve asked the reporter to file it. The current source/versioning.html is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and now links both implementation-registration references to https://fhir.org/implementations/registry/. Current source contains no remaining fhir.org/implementations/usage links. No Confluence reference or later community record was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current source already satisfies FHIR-25118 by linking versioning.html#changes to the working FHIR application registry URL.
